title: Grade 6 French — Fri, May 22
description: Numbers and Time — Day 5 of 5: Synthesis and real-world application
subject: french

questions.question: A train departs at 'huit heures quinze' and arrives 'deux heures trente minutes' later. At what time does it arrive?
questions.explanation: 8h15 + 2h30 = 10h45 = 'dix heures quarante-cinq' or 'onze heures moins le quart'.

questions.question: Sophie's school timetable: Maths at 9h, French at 10h30, lunch at 12h30, Science at 14h. How long is the gap between French and lunch?
questions.explanation: French ends at 10h30 (we assume 1-hour class). Lunch at 12h30. Wait: 12h30 - 10h30 = 2 hours. But if French ends at ~11h30, gap = 1h. Since the question asks French (starts 10h30) to lunch (12h30) = 2 hours.

questions.question: Translate: 'My grandfather is seventy-three years old.'
questions.explanation: 'Soixante-treize' = 73 (60+13). Use 'avoir' for age: 'a soixante-treize ans'. Not 'être'. Not 'septante-trois' (that's Swiss French).

questions.question: A concert is 'le samedi vingt-deux novembre'. Write this date out as a sentence in French.
options: La concert est vingt-deux novembre samedi.
Le concert est le samedi vingt-deux novembre.
Le concert est le vingt-deux novembre, un samedi.
questions.explanation: 'Le concert est le vingt-deux novembre, un samedi' = The concert is on the 22nd of November, a Saturday. Note: article 'le' before date.

questions.question: Read this schedule: 'Le cours commence à neuf heures moins le quart et finit à dix heures et quart.' How long is the class?
questions.explanation: Starts: 9h - 0:15 = 8:45. Ends: 10:15. Duration: 10:15 - 8:45 = 1h30 = une heure et demie.

questions.question: Which is the correct way to express the year 2026 in French?
questions.explanation: 'Deux mille vingt-six' = 2026. Years use 'mille' (thousand): deux mille (2000) + vingt-six (26). No 'et' is used in years.

questions.question: Riya says: 'Je suis née le premier août deux mille douze.' What is her date of birth?
questions.explanation: 'Premier' = 1st, 'août' = August, 'deux mille douze' = 2012. She was born on August 1st, 2012.

questions.question: A French recipe says: 'Faire cuire pendant vingt-cinq minutes à cent quatre-vingts degrés.' What temperature is this?
questions.explanation: 'Cent quatre-vingts' = 180 (100 + 4×20). Cook for 25 minutes at 180 degrees.

questions.question: What is the ordinal number for 'twelfth' in French?
questions.explanation: 'Douzième' = twelfth. For numbers ending in 'e', drop the 'e' before adding '-ième': quatre → quatrième, douze → douzième.

questions.question: Translate: 'There are ninety-nine problems but this test is not one of them.'
questions.explanation: 'Quatre-vingt-dix-neuf' = 99 (4×20+10+9). In standard French (France): quatre-vingt-dix-neuf. (Some countries use 'nonante-neuf' but not standard France.)

questions.question: A shop says 'Ouvert du lundi au vendredi, de neuf heures à dix-huit heures.' How many days is the shop open per week?
questions.explanation: 'Du lundi au vendredi' = from Monday to Friday = 5 days. 'De neuf heures à dix-huit heures' = 9 AM to 6 PM.

questions.question: It's 'quinze heures trente' (24h). A meeting is in 'une heure et quart'. When is the meeting?
Write the phone number 06-92-74-81-35 in French words (first two digits only: 06):
questions.explanation: Phone numbers in French are read in pairs: 06 = 'zéro six', 92 = 'quatre-vingt-douze', 74 = 'soixante-quatorze', etc.

questions.question: What does 'Je suis en sixième' mean in the French school system?
options: I am in 1st year of secondary school (roughly grade 6)
I am in the sixth group
questions.explanation: In France, 'sixième' (6th year) is the FIRST year of collège (secondary school), which corresponds to approximately grade 6 in the Indian/US system.

questions.question: Complete: 'Aujourd'hui, ___ vingt-sept mai deux mille vingt-six.'
options: Les deux 'c'est le' et 'nous sommes le' sont corrects.
questions.explanation: Both 'C'est le vingt-sept mai...' and 'Nous sommes le vingt-sept mai...' are correct ways to express a date in French.
